verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own marketing describes built-in AI features: an AI code reviewer that suggests fixes, AI-powered chat, search, pipeline triage and Jira updates, and AI workflows that can be triggered from Pipelines to handle tasks like cleaning up feature flags, drafting release notes and fixing flaky tests. However, the evidence is only one-line product-page claims. Task delegation is shown mainly as pipeline-triggered workflows rather than a clearly documented in-product assistant that takes tasks. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how users hand tasks to the in-product assistant/chat, scope and limits of delegated actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
